title: auth: create-user answers membershipCreated:false although a sys_member row lands (bootstrap join)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Source: v18.4.0 sweep close-out, #32908 comment 6881136418 (devx#4 ledger, read at `87330e89`), routed by triage.

## What is wrong
Row 214 (records #33087 · 6850382730, #33093 · 6850899929), item `identity-auth.default-organization-boot-invariant`:
- Create-user answers `membershipCreated: false` even though a `sys_member` row lands through the bootstrap join. The response says one thing and the store says another.
- `sys_business_unit_member` rows written on this path are not stamped and log a warning.

## Do
- Make `membershipCreated` report what the store holds, whichever writer made the row.
- Stamp the business-unit member rows the same way other rows on that door are stamped, or say on this card why they are left unstamped.

## Grade
**p2**: the flag in the response is wrong, but no data is wrong or lost.

## Reader
`domain:server`, pilot **Area A1** (plugin-auth).
